title: On the Influence of Gender and Race in Romantic Relationship Prediction from Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in movie script dialogues to compare the recall of predicting romantic relationships between same-gender character pairs versus different-gender character pairs (measuring heteronormative bias).

Counterfactual name substitution in movie script dialogues to measure changes in the recall of romantic relationship predictions for intra-racial versus inter-racial character pairs, using names statistically associated with Asian, Black, Hispanic, and White demographics.
Counterfactual name substitution with anonymized control characters to evaluate if language models associate female names more strongly with romantic relationships than male names.
